posts.body_hr: Tema: InterCapital SBITOP TR UCITS ETF (7SLO). Činjenice (tečajnica ZSE 7. 8. 2026.; factsheet za srpanj 2026.): 1) Pasivni ETF koji fizički replicira SBITOP TR, total-return indeks Ljubljanske burze; dividende se reinvestiraju. 2) Zadnja cijena 68,25 € (7. 8.); neto imovina 84,4 mil. € — najveći ETF na ZSE; na burzi od 16. 11. 2020. 3) TER 0,88 % godišnje. 4) Prinos u zadnjih godinu dana +37,3 % (indeks +37,1 %); 2025.: fond +56,7 %, indeks +57,6 %. 5) Najveće pozicije (srpanj 2026.): Krka 27,1 %, Petrol 19,0 %, NLB 18,3 % — prve tri nose ~64 %. 6) Likvidnost na ZSE: trgovano 243 od 250 radnih dana. 7) Pokazatelji portfelja: P/E 15,3; dividendni prinos sastavnica 3,3 %.
posts.body_en: Topic: InterCapital SBITOP TR UCITS ETF (7SLO). Facts (ZSE price list 7 Aug 2026; July 2026 factsheet): 1) A passive ETF physically replicating SBITOP TR, the total-return index of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange; dividends are reinvested. 2) Last price EUR 68.25 (7 Aug); net assets EUR 84.4M — the largest ETF on the ZSE; listed since 16 Nov 2020. 3) TER 0.88% a year. 4) Return over the past year +37.3% (index +37.1%); 2025: fund +56.7%, index +57.6%. 5) Largest positions (July 2026): Krka 27.1%, Petrol 19.0%, NLB 18.3% — the top three carry ~64%. 6) ZSE liquidity: traded on 243 of 250 working days. 7) Portfolio indicators: P/E 15.3; constituent dividend yield 3.3%.
